name: The Other Side Always With You
source:
Recently, old memories have resurfaced. That time you got lost in the forest…

But why now?

The mark on your wrist no longer hurts—yet now… it almost feels alive

Your daily life goes on as usual: selling ice cream, dealing with strange customers, trying to live a normal life

Until a masked figure appears

So familiar…so impossible to ignore.

[From [url=https://endydreams.itch.io/theothersidealwayswithyou]itch.io[/url]]
